annotations.title: Get global activity data (shipping, ports, air, road)

description: Answers 'how busy is the Suez Canal (or Singapore port, or US airspace) right now?' Give a dataset (chokepoints, ports, port_calls, air, air_europe, air_us or road); optionally match to filter by name or id (e.g. Suez, Singapore, JFK) and dim for air data. Returns daily real-world activity that leads the official statistics: ship transits through 28 chokepoints since 2019, port calls and estimated imports/exports for 2,000+ ports, daily flights by airport, airline, country and region, US flights, cancellations and delays since 1987, and toll and congestion-zone traffic. Taiwan and Korea chip exports are macro series - use get_macro_vintage for those.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

dim.description: For air/air_us: airport, airline, country or region.

match.description: Name or id filter, e.g. Suez Canal, Singapore, JFK, US.

name: get_global_pulse
